title: Microsoft Purview: network data security with Entra Internet Access (Global Secure Access)
summary: Pass: the licensing, administrator-configured default, inspection behavior and automation are supported by Microsoft's documentation and notice. Minor corrections concern abbreviated navigation, differing device prerequisites in two Learn pages, and checklist controls missing from the table.

The pre-check's missing 'Add rule' is not an error: the already-cited tutorial https://learn.microsoft.com/entra/global-secure-access/tutorial-internet-access-content-policies explicitly says 'Select Add rule.'

claims.where: Governance guidance compared with Governance controls
claims.claim: The governance checklist has a corresponding table row for every control it asks administrators to check, configure or monitor.
claims.quote: Check ... the Internet Access forwarding profile, a TLS inspection policy ... Review Data loss prevention > Alerts and Activity explorer ... Query GSA traffic logs ... Table: Purview DLP policy; Entra content policy rule; security-profile user assignment.
claims.fix: Checklist/table coverage mismatch: Before rollout asks administrators to check the Internet Access forwarding profile and TLS inspection policy; At rollout asks them to link the content policy to a security profile; After rollout asks them to review Purview alerts/Activity explorer and GSA logs. None of those controls has its own table row. Do not add rows as part of this correction.
